items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And about this time he had Raymond Valentine on trumpet. And he had Eddie Belfield. You might have heard of him, Eddie Belfield. And Willow Morin

ctx.x: That's the name of the band?

Yeah. And about this time he had Raymond Valentine on trumpet. And he had Eddie Belfield. You might have heard of him, Eddie Belfield. And Willow Morin, we had a, and a fellow by. Doc? Hmm? Doc Morin?
